name: SummEdits
description: SummEdits is a factual consistency benchmark for evaluating whether summaries are consistent with their source documents. It contains 10 domains, each with ~1,000 (document, summary) pairs where summaries may be factually consistent or inconsistent. Tests models' ability to detect hallucinations and factual errors in generated summaries.
reputation: Factual consistency benchmark for summarization; published at EMNLP 2023; tests hallucination detection across 10 diverse domains
notes: Published at EMNLP 2023. 10 domains including news articles, science papers, conversations, medical notes, and more. Each inconsistency requires understanding the full document context. Balanced 50/50 consistent/inconsistent split. Harder than previous factual consistency benchmarks because inconsistencies are subtle and require deep reading.
